continuitySourceGapPolicy: Categories without Stage 1 source text are source-gap/candidate-only; do not invent continuity facts.
appearancePolicy: Future extraction must create source-backed appearance fragments or not-found markers per relevant source unit.
outfitEquipmentPolicy: Future extraction must create outfit/equipment fragments or not-found markers; equipment includes glasses, knives, Black Keys, Seventh Holy Scripture, Ciel uniforms, Arcueid outfits.
abilityActivationPolicy: Future extraction must distinguish ability definition, activation scene, visual effect, mechanical effect, cost/consequence.
combatEffectPolicy: Future extraction must include actor, effect type, visual effect, result, affected targets, sourceRefs, or not-found marker.
relationshipPolicy: Formal edge later requires from/to/type/timelineId/timeRange/sourceRefs; candidate co-occurrence is not enough.
timelinePolicy: Formal event later requires time.start, time.end, timelineNodes; long events need start/middle/end; use relative-only if date unknown.
notFoundPolicy: Not-found markers are mandatory when source lacks explicit detail; absence cannot be silent.
